$comment: Contract for one line of workspace/seed_records/traces.jsonl, written by scripts/seed_harvest.py record (_collect): the calls one traced process made to the API, in order (at most MAX_TRACE_CALLS, more than one). Each call has the bytes recorded per argument (`args`: index -> [kind, offset, hex]), the pointer addresses that link calls within the process (`addrs`), and the largest buffer recorded per argument (`sizes`). Read by api_harness.py (sequence cases) and seed_harvest.py write (sequence seeds).
